# NSE India Daily OHLC, Bhavcopy and Delivery Data

> Date-partitioned CSV archive of NSE India daily security OHLC prices, bhavcopy trading statistics, volume, deliverable quantity, and delivery percentage from 30 September 2019 onward.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/olo-labs/olo-testdata-nse-day-delivery-candle
Data directory: Day_Delivery/NSE
File pattern: Day_Delivery/NSE/delivery_DD-MMM-YYYY.csv
Logical row key: DATE1 + SYMBOL + SERIES
Source report: NSE Full Bhavcopy and Security Deliverable data

## Primary documentation

- README.md: Overview, quick start, layout, automation, licensing, and caveats.
- docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md: Definitions for all 15 CSV columns, units, and relationships.
- docs/USAGE.md: Python, pandas, PowerShell, and DuckDB examples.
- docs/DATA_QUALITY.md: Known issues, validation, and reporting requirements.
- docs/FAQ.md: Direct answers to common NSE data questions.
- CONTRIBUTING.md: Contribution and data-correction requirements.
- metadata/dataset.jsonld: Schema.org Dataset metadata.
- metadata/csvw.json: Machine-readable CSV column schema.
- CITATION.cff: Citation metadata.

## Core schema

SYMBOL, SERIES, DATE1, PREV_CLOSE, OPEN_PRICE, HIGH_PRICE, LOW_PRICE, LAST_PRICE, CLOSE_PRICE, AVG_PRICE, TTL_TRD_QNTY, TURNOVER_LACS, NO_OF_TRADES, DELIV_QTY, DELIV_PER

Daily candle: OPEN_PRICE, HIGH_PRICE, LOW_PRICE, CLOSE_PRICE.
Delivery: DELIV_QTY is deliverable quantity; DELIV_PER is delivery percentage.
Volume: TTL_TRD_QNTY is total traded quantity; TURNOVER_LACS is turnover in lakh rupees for INR-denominated instruments.

## Important interpretation rules

- Data is raw exchange-reported values, not corporate-action-adjusted prices.
- Use DATE1 + SYMBOL + SERIES as the logical key.
- LAST_PRICE can differ from official CLOSE_PRICE.
- Not every calendar day has a report; special weekend sessions can exist.
- Validate files before analysis; docs/DATA_QUALITY.md records a known malformed file.
- Apache-2.0 covers project code/docs; underlying NSE data has separate rights and policies.
- This independent repository is not affiliated with NSE and is not investment advice.
